rulingGate.verdict: BLOCKED. (1) Under the temporary flip every journal-only command measured lost its effect from the journal projection after a whole-envelope PUT whose envelope did not carry it. (2) The campaign command route has no production caller, but the co-op host door is a production flow of the same journal-only commands on the same campaign stream; after the flip every new co-op campaign is journal-native, and the host browser's next whole-envelope save does not carry a HirePilot's pilot (nor an AcceptContract's contract or an AllocateSalvage's pool); measured row (c1): the pilot is gone from the journal projection after that save.

proposedSuccessor.behavior: Journal-only campaign effects survive a whole-envelope save. (1) A committed campaign command that appends without rewriting the campaigns row, through the command route (campaignCommandPipeline.ts batch path) or the co-op host door (CampaignMatchHost commits through commitCampaignEventBatch on the durable journal store), rewrites the saved record in the same immediate transaction as its append (the AcceptContract materialization pattern, campaignAcceptContractCommand.ts:457-620, through campaignRecordRow's borrowed-handle write), so the row version advances and a whole-envelope PUT at the pre-command version answers 409 with the server record instead of checkpointing over the effect. (2) A CampaignSnapshotPublished record checkpoint carries forward the journal's ledger-only state that the record does not represent (pilots, contracts, salvagePool), which authoritativeStateFromSerializedCampaign leaves empty (campaignSourceGenesis.ts:57-89), so a checkpoint never erases a ledger-only effect. Red-first: U35d admission probe rows (r1), (r2), (r3) and (c1) (saved copy, sha256 in this receipt), red on 992b2babc under the temporary flip.
proposedSuccessor.estimate: INFERENCE, not measured: 6-9 files; the row rewrite for the co-op door needs the server to patch balance, currentDate and faction standing onto the stored envelope body, and part (2) is a merge in the checkpoint builder; may need splitting into (2) first, (1) second
openQuestionsForTheParent: With (1), the co-op host browser's next debounced save after each co-op commit meets the CAS and answers 409; runSave then rolls a co-op campaign back and toasts (useCampaignPersistenceStore.ts:832-858). Either the host browser refetches after folding a committed frame (src/stores/campaign or src/components/campaign/coop, outside the proposed paths) or the 409 recovery is accepted; the parent decides.
Whether (2) alone is acceptable for the co-op door (the host fold already carries balance/day/standing) and (1) only for the command route, which has no production caller today.

risksForTheParent: Authority: the blocking consequence above goes live for every new co-op campaign the moment the flip lands; it is already live today for any journal-native campaign (fixture-armed e2e runs, the scripts/e2e cutover CLI, operator cutovers), as the baseline rows show.

Idempotency: the co-op host keeps its own in-memory state (CampaignMatchHost.ts:150) and reads only the next sequence from the store (campaignEventLog.ts:64-67), so after a checkpoint its batches carry expected post-state digests computed from a state the journal no longer replays to (c1: the host holds the pilot, the journal does not); any reader that re-derives state from the journal (the command route, replica sync, launch head) sees the checkpoint's state.
